measurement_classes.DIRECT_RETROSPECTIVE_MEASUREMENT: The retained record directly supports the metric without substituting a different quantity.
measurement_classes.DIRECT_EXECUTED_MEASUREMENT: The governed measurement protocol was executed on a declared environment and its direct result was retained as a governed candidate.
measurement_classes.RETROSPECTIVE_MECHANICAL_VERIFICATION: Deterministic archive/render structure supports the metric mechanically, but the result is not a human-performance measure.
measurement_classes.PROXY_OBSERVATION: A related quantity is observable but must not be represented as the required metric.
measurement_classes.NOT_DIRECTLY_OBSERVED: The governed record does not contain the required measurement; no value is inferred.

case_evaluations.note: Governance/control-plane case retains exact-head review, Human Steward authority, successful checks, protected merge and readback.
Administrative-automation case retains terminal docket state and bounded nonclaims without expanding authority.
Documentary-governed migration case preserves pre-ratification historical snapshots rather than rewriting them.
Repository integration is complete while DEPTH reopening requirements and mathematical nonclaims remain explicitly separate claim-layer residuals.
Theorem/certification case retains its certification chain and distinct Human Steward source shape.

The failed required Programme-policy check remains visible despite two other required checks succeeding; the non-independent CHANGES_REQUESTED signal remains history rather than being mislabeled as independent review.
Head movement invalidates the old review boundary. The governed review-body binding and conflicting raw REST review commit_id are both preserved rather than silently reconciled.
Low-complexity one-file receipt correctly represents Human Steward authorization as not required rather than missing.

reviewer_time_to_operative_state.limitation: Review-request-to-approval latency does not measure the time required to identify operative state from the report and must not be substituted for that governed metric.

factual_state_identification_accuracy.limitation: Mechanical agreement between retained case classification and rendered state is not a timed human factual-error measurement.

blocker_residual_detection.interpretation: P06 is correctly blocked by a failed required repository check; P04 remains repository-complete while scientific reopening requirements and nonclaims remain visible as orthogonal residuals.

stale_report_detection.interpretation: The report fails closed to STALE when exact head and current head diverge.

source_render_disagreement_rate.limitation: This measures deterministic canonical-source to derivative consistency under the C09 bundle contract. P07 contains a retained disagreement between two source records; that source-source discrepancy is intentionally not counted as a renderer disagreement.

regeneration_latency.interpretation: Isolated canonical report resealing plus deterministic text/SVG regeneration completed across all eight retained cases with no semantic or derivative mismatch. GitHub network latency and whole-repository CI fanout were excluded.

operational_cost.limitation: These are repository/storage and change-surface costs. They do not by themselves quantify reviewer cognitive cost; isolated regeneration compute cost is now separately measured.

accessibility_text_equivalence_fidelity.interpretation: Each retained case has a textual equivalent and deterministic SVG derivative from the same canonical report input; SVG status is textual and carries an image role/aria label rather than relying on color alone.
accessibility_text_equivalence_fidelity.limitation: This is structural and deterministic equivalence evidence, not a user study of assistive-technology usability.

findings: The common lifecycle spine represented all eight heterogeneous cases without collapsing domain-specific modules or nonclaims.
The adverse failed-check control P06 remained BLOCKED even though most required checks were green.
The moving-head control P07 failed closed to STALE and preserved the old review as historical.
The source/claim case P04 demonstrated that repository lifecycle completion and mathematical residuals are orthogonal and must remain separately visible.
Deterministic JSON/text/SVG/receipt bundles provide strong source-to-render and accessibility-structure evidence.

Isolated deterministic regeneration is directly measured at aggregate median 0.4672675 ms and p95 0.538335 ms over 240 samples, with zero deterministic-equivalence failures; admission state at retention was candidate.
The governed record still does not directly measure human time-to-operative-state or human factual error rate.

characterized_gaps.required_action: Execute and retain issue #442 with at least two genuine independent human reviewers under the balanced report-first/source-only crossover protocol.
